payload.core_composition_summary: Binary search on answer with a greedy check that uses reverse-sorted sales to maximize discounted purchases.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts sales, then binary searches the minimum day, using a greedy check that processes sales in reverse order to optimally buy discounted items. Two distinct mechanisms: sorting and greedy.
